problem_statement: This is the anse-app ChatGPT-API demo: a Solid + Astro chat interface with a header (product logo, 'ChatGPT Demo' title and 'Based on OpenAI API' line), a message composer and streaming transcript on the home chat surface at /, plus two reference pages rendered from the same shell — a Models page at /models/ and a Prompts page at /prompts/. A first-time visitor lands on an empty thread, so the team wants a native 'Starter conversation': a small seeded example transcript rendered with the demo's own chat bubbles (a user turn and an assistant turn, each with an avatar, a message body and a wrapping row of per-message meta chips), shown in the conversation column of every surface, plus a header Quick-prompts control whose starter chips append a new turn to a live preview thread and update a 'Conversation: N turns' readout. Ship the Starter conversation so it (1) appears in the conversation column of the Chat home, Models AND Prompts surfaces alike, (2) lays out each message's meta-chip row responsively so no surface overflows horizontally on a 390px phone, (3) keeps the bubbles readable and on-brand (legible light message text on raised dark cards, avatars beside the text) rather than unreadable dark-on-dark bubbles with overlapping avatars, and (4) wires the Quick-prompts chips so that clicking a starter appends a new turn bubble and the readout re-reads the live turn count as 'Conversation: 2 turns'. Keep the rest of the demo — the composer, the theme toggle, the header copy and the Astro build — intact with no console or network errors.
required_content: Add a shared 'Starter conversation' example transcript in the conversation column so it renders on the Chat home (/), the Models page (/models/) AND the Prompts page (/prompts/) — a shared component rendered from the page shells, not a per-page copy.

The transcript shows a 'Starter conversation' label and seeded chat turns rendered as the demo's own bubbles: a user turn and an assistant turn, each with an avatar, a message body and a row of per-message meta chips (model, tokens, latency, mode).
Each message's meta-chip row must wrap responsively so no surface overflows horizontally on a 390px phone (overflow tolerance 24px).

Keep the bubbles readable and on-brand (legible light message text on raised dark cards, avatars beside the text), not unreadable dark-on-dark message text with avatars overlapping the first line or bubbles that collide.

Add a Quick-prompts control in the always-present header with a live preview thread and a 'Conversation: N turns' readout, and wire it so that clicking a starter chip appends a new turn bubble and the readout re-reads the LIVE turn count as 'Conversation: 2 turns' — not a value snapshotted at setup.
Preserve the composer, the theme toggle, the header copy and the Astro build with no console or network errors.
design_constraints: Implement the Starter conversation as a shared component rendered from the page shells so a single source of truth reaches every surface; do not paste divergent copies per page or ship a detached widget.
Each message's meta-chip row must use a fluid, wrapping layout (no fixed-width nowrap track) so it never forces horizontal overflow on tablet or mobile.

The bubbles must stay legible and on-brand: light message text on raised dark cards with distinct avatars beside the text, not near-invisible dark-on-dark text, absolutely-positioned avatars overlapping the message, or negative margins that collide consecutive turns.

Place the Quick-prompts readout in the always-present header, separate from the seeded transcript itself, and make it reflect the CURRENT turn count after every click by reading the live rendered thread, so it can never go stale relative to the bubbles actually shown.
Do not remove or regress the composer, the theme toggle, the header copy or the Astro build.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial protect the Chat home surface across viewports.
desktop_models, mobile_models and desktop_prompts protect the Models and Prompts reference pages and must carry the Starter conversation in the conversation column.
desktop_thread_home and mobile_thread_home scroll the Starter conversation into view and must show readable dark bubbles without horizontal overflow.
desktop_thread_models protects the Starter conversation's presence on the Models reference page.
quick_prompt_home clicks a starter chip in the header Quick-prompts control; a new turn bubble must then appear and the readout must read 'Conversation: 2 turns'.

change_completion: The Starter conversation is present in the conversation column of the Chat home, Models AND Prompts surfaces (the shared component reaches all three).

After clicking a starter chip in the header Quick-prompts control on the Chat home, a new turn bubble is appended and the readout updates to 'Conversation: 2 turns' — the post-interaction terminal state changed from the single seeded turn.
design_consistency: The seeded bubbles on the thread states match the reference's readable dark chat styling under the visual-regression gate (pixel/ssim/block-fidelity), not unreadable dark-on-dark bubbles with overlapping avatars.
The transcript adopts the dark chat brand tokens (raised dark bubble cards, teal-accented meta chips, distinct avatars) so it reads as the demo's own conversation across every page.
responsive: No captured surface overflows horizontally beyond 24px on a 390px phone; each message's meta-chip row wraps.
desktop_thread_home, mobile_thread_home and desktop_thread_models keep the Starter conversation readable across viewports without clipping or overflow.
regression: The composer and the theme toggle remain present and functional.
The header copy and the Astro build are not removed or broken, with no console or network errors.

author_notes: slot_197 REBUILD to native-lever L4 on the anse-app chatgpt-demo Solid + Astro chat interface (still on the reassigned repo, off the shared BrockAltug chat-pwa-demo that triple-duplicated with slots 53 and 310). The prior L4 bolted a generic Assistant-readiness metric rail beneath the composer — a KPI strip in a chat window — so the lever was rebuilt onto the product's OWN surface: a Starter conversation seeded transcript rendered with the demo's chat bubbles (MessageItem-style avatar + message body) plus a header Quick-prompts control that appends a live turn. The composer, the theme toggle, the header copy and the dark brand tokens are byte-identical across legs. The levers ride on a new shared StarterConversation component rendered from the page shells plus a QuickPrompts island in the always-present header. reference = transcript on all three surfaces, wrapping meta rows, readable dark bubbles, and a quick-prompt click that appends a turn and re-reads the live count (passes D2/D3/D4/D6). baseline = the original unrepaired transcript: present on the Chat home surface only (fails D2 cross-page on the Models/Prompts pages), a fixed 760px nowrap meta row (fails D6 mobile overflow ~519px), off-brand light-cream bubbles (fails D3 visual), but its quick-prompt click DOES append and re-read live (passes D4). bad = a 'smart wrong' transcript: present on the Chat home only (fails D2 on Models/Prompts), a 600px min-width nowrap meta row with a shallow inner overflow-x:hidden non-fix (fails D6 mobile ~257px), unreadable dark-on-dark bubbles with absolutely-positioned overlapping avatars and colliding turns (fails D3), and a quick-prompt handler that pushes into a throwaway array with a readout snapshotted once at setup so the chip lights up but no turn is appended and the readout stays 'Conversation: 1 turns' (fails D4) — bad fails 4 orthogonal gates. The Astro build renders every surface fully static, the PWA and SSR API endpoints are removed and the logo icon is inlined, so every leg is offline-clean.
